# tflori/orm

> A lightweight object relational mapper for PHP (7.3+): entities, relations, query builder, events and testing
> helpers without a real database.

A short usage guide is shipped with the package: `vendor/tflori/orm/USAGE.md`
(https://github.com/tflori/orm/blob/master/USAGE.md).

## Docs

- [Configuration](https://tflori.github.io/orm/configuration.html): EntityManager options and connections
- [Entity Definition](https://tflori.github.io/orm/entityDefinition.html): table names, columns, primary keys
- [Working With Entities](https://tflori.github.io/orm/entities.html): create, fetch, save and delete entities
- [Relation Definition](https://tflori.github.io/orm/relationDefinition.html): cheat sheet and all relation types
- [Working With Relations](https://tflori.github.io/orm/relations.html): fetch, set and eager load relations
- [Events and Observers](https://tflori.github.io/orm/events.html)
- [Use QueryBuilder](https://tflori.github.io/orm/querybuilder.html)
- [Testing](https://tflori.github.io/orm/testing.html): MocksEntityManager and expectations on results
- [Upgrade Guide](https://tflori.github.io/orm/upgrade.html): what changed between versions

## Optional

- [Filters](https://tflori.github.io/orm/filters.html)
- [Validate Data](https://tflori.github.io/orm/validate.html)
- [Bulk Inserts](https://tflori.github.io/orm/bulkInserts.html)
- [API Reference](https://tflori.github.io/orm/reference.html)
